<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$cart = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: $_POST;
$total = 0.0; $items = [];
foreach ($cart as $sku => $qty) {
    if (!isset($PRODUCTS[$sku])) continue;
    $p = $PRODUCTS[$sku];
    $items[] = \PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\ItemBuilder::init($p['name'], \PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $p['price'])->build(), (string)$qty)->build();
    $total += $p['price'] * (int)$qty;
}
if ($total <= 0) { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'empty cart']); exit; }
$r = $orders->createOrder(['body' => \PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\OrderRequestBuilder::init('CAPTURE', [
    \PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder::init(
        \PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\AmountWithBreakdownBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))
            ->breakdown(\PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\AmountBreakdownBuilder::init()->itemTotal(\PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))->build())->build())->build()
    )->items($items)->build()
])->build(), 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
$orderId = $r->getResult()->getId();
orders_save(['token' => $orderId, 'amount' => number_format($total, 2, '.', ''), 'status' => 'CREATED', 'created' => date('c')]);
echo json_encode(['id' => $orderId]);

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$in = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
$orderId = $in['orderId'] ?? '';
$order = orders_get($orderId);
if (!$order) { http_response_code(404); echo json_encode(['error' => 'unknown order']); exit; }
if ($order['status'] === 'PAID') { echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]); exit; }
try {
    $res = $orders->captureOrder(['id' => $orderId, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
    $capture = $res->getResult()->getPurchaseUnits()[0]->getPayments()->getCaptures()[0];
    $order['status'] = 'PAID';
    $order['transaction_id'] = $capture->getId();
    orders_save($order);
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]);
} catch (Exception $e) { http_response_code(502); echo json_encode(['error' => 'capture failed']); }
changes: Added idempotency check for already captured orders

require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/orders_store.php';
function verifyWebhook($raw, $headers) {
    $token = base64_encode(getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID') . ':' . getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET'));
    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Authorization: Basic ' . $token, 'Content-Type: application/json']);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode(['auth_algo' => $headers['HTTP_PAYPAL_AUTH_ALGO'], 'cert_url' => $headers['HTTP_PAYPAL_CERT_URL'], 'transmission_id' => $headers['HTTP_PAYPAL_TRANSMISSION_ID'], 'transmission_sig' => $headers['HTTP_PAYPAL_TRANSMISSION_SIG'], 'transmission_time' => $headers['HTTP_PAYPAL_TRANSMISSION_TIME'], 'webhook_id' => getenv('PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID'), 'webhook_event' => json_decode($raw)]));
    $res = json_decode(curl_exec($ch), true);
    return ($res['verification_status'] ?? '') === 'SUCCESS';
}
$raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
if (verifyWebhook($raw, $_SERVER)) {
    $event = json_decode($raw, true);

}
